owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.description: The addendum (recommendation 8) treats blockers and user decisions as a first-class workflow with its own states and content, kept apart from routine retries, failover and the lease recoveries that recover() (SO-08-B AC01) resolves by itself. SO-03-A has gates and memev work decisions (AC02, AC04); SO-C-A AC04 serves /api/decisions; SO-C-C has the outstanding-work view; none has the decision entity with states. This contract adds it to the store's validator list and extends the command and the endpoint.

stop_rules: Stop and post BLOCKED when a criterion cannot pass without weakening a test, skipping a test or relaxing an assertion.
Stop and ask when the work would name a client product, a person, a server or a seat in repository text; the client names live in docs/CLIENTS.md only.
Stop when the work would add a runtime dependency, a model call, a network call at install or start, a second store for project state, or any reporting that is not opt-in and off by default.
Stop when the work would move convergence logic into the core, vendor the engine, or add a merge engine beside the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs.
If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.

title: SO-A-05 Decision and blocker queue as a workflow: seven states, severity and consequence of waiting, routine recoveries never become decisions, recommendations are never answers, answers recalculate dependents
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-A-05) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design record SO-1.08 (Decision queue: blockers and user decisions as one workflow with named states) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Builds on signed vault contracts: SO-03-A†, SO-08-B†, SO-C-A†, SO-C-C†, SO-L-A†. Memev contracts that land first: SO-A-04, SO-1.01. Source in the fold: #222 recommendation 8 (blockers and user decisions as a first-class workflow). Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) Prerequisite SO-1.01 added. The seven decision states are a separate entity from TASK_STATES, which are unchanged. (4) The decision owner field names a subject, not a role matrix: the role-by-action matrix is ADR 5 (open) and is not decided here.
